meta.study: Teacher-view design in nuclear SSL — pre-registered three-arm controlled study
meta.design: ViT-S/8 continued-training adaptation, identical budget & probe contract, paired patient/tile-level bootstrap, 2 seeds, bit-level closure rerun

gates.detail: both task families prefer the same 40px view; pos-embed interpolation confound noted

gates.name: G1 necessity (C > A0)
gates.detail: T1 +3.77 [2.94, 4.55], T2 +4.59 [0.44, 9.13] — cross-view signal itself helps

gates.name: G2 irreducibility (C − C1 ≥ 1pp)
gates.detail: T1/T2 pass; T3 organ reverses across seeds

gates.name: G3+G3′ teacher info source (B vs C)
gates.detail: B − C = +2.96 [1.92, 3.99] pure content effect after confound exclusion → co-visible restriction judged unnecessary

gates.name: Closure rerun (bit-level)
gates.detail: config-identical rerun of arm B: loss matches to 4 decimals, T1 Δ +0.14pp within cudnn jitter

gain: 96.3% of the in-domain gain sits in the frozen anchor's bottom margin quartile (median percentile 0.18 → +0.30) — the low-confidence mass is reshaped.
66% of the gain comes from the anchor's two weakest classes (Epithelial +1.17 pp, Dead +1.14 pp); false positives drop in all five classes, none are hurt.
Clustered cells gain more than isolated ones (Spearman +0.052/+0.044 at r=64/128 px) — context statistics, not truncated-neighborhood fill.
cost: Cross-domain macro-F1 cost concentrates on one pre-existing confusable family: Neutrophil F1 −21.6 pp (35× noise floor) via precision collapse, recall unchanged.

Mechanism is a broad content-level probability shift with re-ranking — not context leakage (0/64 false positives had a same-class neighbor), not regularization strength (matched-C), no feature aliasing.
No new confusion modes: a 16-model confusion audit shows the family edge in all of them; late-layer drift amplitude does not carry the push (direction ≈ 0).
